parameters.content:
## Multi-Format Document Converter

Upload any document → Code detects format (PDF/DOCX/HTML/TXT/Excel) →
HTTP conversion API converts to target format → saved to Drive → email notification.

Supports: PDF↔DOCX, PDF↔HTML, DOCX→PDF, HTML→PDF, Excel→PDF

**Setup:**
1. Configure document conversion API (e.g., CloudConvert)
2. Set Google Drive destination folder
3. Set Gmail credentials
4. POST { targetFormat: 'pdf', notifyEmail: '...' } + binary file
